rationale: One source-level link in the explained StopSign-resync account still deserved an explicit record: how a leader that holds a prepare quorum can nevertheless lack a StopSign that an accept quorum already contains. handle_majority_promises merges only the log_sync attached to the single greatest promise seen when the prepare quorum forms, and handle_promise_accept records a later Promise and answers it with an AcceptSync but never merges its log_sync. A follower that accepts the StopSign and then promises late therefore contributes its accepted index to later Accepted replies without ever handing the StopSign to the leader. That is the missing piece between the run-13 trace, where the AcceptSync ended at 37, and the decide at 38 that the earlier source note explained as a count over reported accepted indices.

knowledge.statement: handle_majority_promises applies exactly one promise log_sync, the one kept as max_promise_sync while promises are collected in the Prepare phase. handle_promise_accept, the path for a Promise that arrives once the leader is already in the Accept phase, only records the promise metadata and sends that follower an AcceptSync; it never merges the Promise's log_sync into the leader's storage. A follower that accepted a StopSign and then promises after the prepare quorum therefore does not give the leader that StopSign, even though it is part of an accept quorum at the StopSign's index and reports that index in later Accepted replies, which is_chosen counts toward the leader's decision.
knowledge.conditions: SequencePaxos leader that reached a prepare quorum without any log_sync containing the StopSign; the StopSign-holding follower's Promise arrives after the leader switched to Phase::Accept; no snapshots involved.

knowledge.assertion: Explains the run-13 chain: a late-promising follower's StopSign never reached leader 4 through the Promise, so create_log_sync had no StopSign to attach to node 3's AcceptSync, while the same follower's later Accepted reply could still make index 38 chosen and produce the clamped Decides.
